title: A request in a word the real GLOSSARY.md says to avoid
pattern: vocabulary drift against a glossary in a large tree
expectation: Chosen because GLOSSARY.md at the root lists "seat ownership" under Owning seat as a term to avoid (the canonical words are owning seat and unowned), CLAUDE.md points at the glossary, and the prompt uses the avoided phrase. Without guidance the agent adopts the user's phrase in file names, function names, comments and test titles (seat-ownership.mjs, findSeatOwnership) instead of the glossary's.
prompt: Add a helper under claude-plugins/task-orchestrator/hooks/lib that reports which notes of a note schema have no seat ownership. It takes the schema's note entries and the seats the schema declares, and returns the note keys. Add a test.

checks.pattern: avoided term in a file name
avoided term in code, comments or tests
scope creep: unrelated existing files changed
